greet.speaker: Arena Steward
greet.text: "Welcome to the Trials! Three challengers stand between you and the Champion. Win, and their gear is yours to keep — lose, and, well, you'll wake up back at the cave entrance. We're not monsters."
greet.text_zh: 「歡迎來到試煉場！三位挑戰者擋在你與王者之間。贏了，他們的裝備就歸你；輸了嘛……你會在洞窟入口醒來。我們又不是怪物。」

champion_lore.speaker: Arena Steward
champion_lore.text: "Undefeated, longer than I've worked here — and I've worked here a long time. Some say the Champion doesn't even want to keep winning anymore. Nobody's tested that theory yet."
champion_lore.text_zh: 「不敗紀錄，比我在這裡工作的時間還長——而我可是待了很久了。有人說王者其實早就不想再贏下去了。不過還沒人真的去驗證這個說法。」
